name: W New York - Union Square
positioning: The second W ever built, in a 1919 Beaux-Arts building on Union Square, with New York-inspired room design, a rooftop bar over the park and a subway-themed gym
best_for: Design-minded travelers who want a hotel full of New York references
City explorers who want subway lines and the Greenmarket steps away

facts.text: The hotel is in a Beaux-Arts building blended with future-forward design.
The building on the hotel's site was built in 1919 and first commissioned by Germania Life Insurance.
The carpet design is inspired by the Faig Ahmed artwork Doubts.
The hotel sits at the intersection of Uptown and Downtown Manhattan.
The Living Room Bar & Lounge is a former ballroom turned bar, with live sound programming Wednesday through Saturday.
Bathrooms have taxicab-inspired faucet handles and Davines amenities.
The Penthouse I Suite has an eye-catching minibar as its centerpiece and a bedroom with an ombre pattern, original artwork and plenty of natural light.
Specially commissioned original artwork hangs throughout the hotel.
The gym has a Peloton bike room, Technogym cardio and weight equipment and HydroMassage technology.
Multiple subway lines are steps from the hotel.
The hotel team can set up sightseeing trips around the city, including by boat or helicopter.
On check-in, pets receive a pet toy, pet treat, W Hotels pet tag and clean-up bags.

highlights.text: The hotel was the second W ever built worldwide.

Room designs include wall sconces that evoke the lighting at NYC subway station entrances, chessboard tables and curved lacquer panels, with black and white stripe accents that recall NYC's crosswalks.
Guardian Rooftop is a rooftop bar with sweeping views south over the park and the downtown skyline.
The FIT gym is on the basement level, a subway-inspired space with supersized mosaics referencing NYC's metro stations.
The Greenmarket, one of the city's year-round farmers' markets, is steps from the hotel.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
